FilterValue: 'Contrato - Información para envío de contrato Preliminar y Final'
Name: PVU_GetOrdersContract

FormulaExpression:
IF(%OrderItemPlan:%vlocity_namespace%__AttributeSelectedValues__c% LIKE "B2C-ATTR-SI-SMS-NAL", 
    IF(%OrderItemPlan:%vlocity_namespace%__AttributeSelectedValues__c% LIKE "B2C-ATTR-SI-DATOS", 
        IF(%OrderItemPlan:%vlocity_namespace%__AttributeSelectedValues__c% LIKE "B2C-ATTR-SI-VOZ-NAL",
            "1,2,3",
            "1,2"
        ),
        IF(%OrderItemPlan:%vlocity_namespace%__AttributeSelectedValues__c% LIKE "B2C-ATTR-SI-VOZ-NAL",
            "1,3",
            "1"
        ),
    ),
    IF(%OrderItemPlan:%vlocity_namespace%__AttributeSelectedValues__c% LIKE "B2C-ATTR-SI-DATOS",
        IF(%OrderItemPlan:%vlocity_namespace%__AttributeSelectedValues__c% LIKE "B2C-ATTR-SI-VOZ-NAL",
            "2,3",
            "2"),
        IF(%OrderItemPlan:%vlocity_namespace%__AttributeSelectedValues__c% LIKE "B2C-ATTR-SI-VOZ-NAL",
            "3", " ")),
)
Name: PVU_GetOrdersContract

FormulaExpression:
IF(ISNOTBLANK(BillCycle), IF(
     FUNCTION('CustomOmniStudioFunctions', 'toNumber', BillCycle) > FUNCTION('CustomOmniStudioFunctions', 'toNumber', DAY(TODAY())),
    CONCAT(
      BillCycle,
      "/",
      FORMATDATETIME(TODAY(), "MM/yyyy")
    ),
    CONCAT(
      BillCycle,
      "/",
      FORMATDATETIME(ADDMONTH(TODAY(), 1), "MM/yyyy")
    )
  ), "")
Name: PVU_GetOrdersContract

FormulaExpression: IF(ISNOTBLANK(formCutOffDetails), IF( FUNCTION('CustomOmniStudioFunctions', 'toNumber', formCutOffDetails) > FUNCTION('CustomOmniStudioFunctions', 'toNumber', DAY(TODAY())), CONCAT(formCutOffDetails, "/", FORMATDATETIME(TODAY(), "MM/yyyy")), CONCAT(formCutOffDetails, "/", FORMATDATETIME(ADDMONTH(TODAY(), 1), "MM/yyyy"))), "")
Name: PVU_GetOrdersContract

FormulaExpression: IF(Order:FVU_PurchaseType__c = "POR", OrderItemRoot:FVU_PortinActivationDate__c, IF(Order:FVU_PurchaseType__c = "ACT", ADDDAY(Order:EffectiveDate, 20), IF(Case:PVU_Level2__c = "Cambio de número" || Case:PVU_Level2__c = "Cambio de plan" ||  Case:PVU_Level2__c = "Activación/Desactivación Servicios Adicionales y Funcionalidades" || Case:PVU_Level2__c = "Cambio de ciclo" ,Order:EffectiveDate, " ")))
Name: PVU_GetOrdersContract
